1. **`src/services/completions.ts`, `isNativeFunctionMethod`** — deprioritizes by name match alone (`apply`, `call`, `bind`, `length`, `name`, etc.) against any object type with call signatures, without checking the symbol actually resolves to `Function.prototype`/`CallableFunction`. A custom function-valued interface that legitimately declares its own `name`, `length`, `call`, or `apply` member (e.g. a callable with a `call: () => void` business method, or a `length` property) will have that member wrongly demoted even though it isn't the native one. Fix: compare the symbol's declaration (or the symbol itself) against the actual members of the global `Function` interface/`Function.prototype` symbol (e.g. resolve `typeChecker.resolveName("Function", ...)` or check `symbol === functionType.getProperty(symbol.name)` from the lib's Function type) rather than matching by name.

2. **`src/services/completions.ts`, `isNativeFunctionMethod` signature/behavior** — the whole-word diff shows every line in `isStaticProperty`/the new function reformatted (CRLF/whitespace churn) even though only new code was added; this is noise that will blow up the real diff and make review/blame harder. Fix: don't reformat unrelated existing lines (`isStaticProperty`, the `addTypeProperties`/`addPropertySymbol` bodies) — keep the diff surgical as the PR description claims.

3. **`src/services/completions.ts`, `isNativeFunctionMethod`** — dead/misleading check: `type.flags & TypeFlags.Object` followed by `type.getCallSignatures()` is redundant and also wrong for the stated goal — intersection/union function types (e.g. `(() => void) & Bun.InspectFunction`, or a union where only one branch is callable) won't have `TypeFlags.Object` set and will skip deprioritization entirely, silently regressing the exact Bun.inspect-style case (Bun's real types often use intersections). Fix: check `some(type.getCallSignatures())` directly without gating on `TypeFlags.Object`.

4. **`tests/cases/fourslash/*.ts` (all three new files)** — missing trailing newline (diff shows "No newline at end of file" for all three), inconsistent with repo convention. Fix: add trailing newlines.

5. **`tests/cases/fourslash/*.ts`** — hardcodes literal sort-text strings (`"11"`, `"111"`, `"10"`) instead of importing/referencing the `SortText` constants or using the documented fourslash helpers, making tests silently stale if `SortText` values ever change. Fix: follow existing fourslash conventions for asserting relative ordering (e.g. many existing tests just check order/presence) or at minimum comment is not enough — verify against actual exported constants if the harness exposes them, or assert relative order instead of magic numbers.

6. **`src/services/completions.ts`, `addSymbolSortInfo`** — this only ever downgrades priority for symbols matching native names; it does nothing to rule out the case where the function type is `Function` itself (completing directly on `Function.prototype`, e.g. `let f: Function; f.`), where every member is "native" and will all get bumped to `SortBelow`, which is a no-op change in relative order but silently depends on there being no other symbols — should have a test confirming plain `Function`-typed completions aren't regressed (e.g. ordering within `Function.prototype`'s own members becomes arbitrary/unspecified). Add a test for this baseline case.

7. **Overall test coverage gap** — no test for a function type that overrides/shadows a native member with a differently-typed same-name member via declaration merging or intersection (the case most likely to break under issue #1's name-only matching, e.g. Bun's actual `.name`/`.length` overrides), and no test for arrow functions / method shorthand properties holding function values reached via inferred (not declared) types. Given this PR's entire premise is Bun-style APIs, add a regression test exercising a custom `call`-or-`name`-named member to prove issue #1 is actually handled correctly.
